0／design-in 0／design win 0／installed base 0／qualified by 0／long-term contract 0／long-term agreement 0／multi-year 1（自社のsite consolidation計画）／lock-in 0／barriers to entry 0／new entrants 0／customer は**当社の原材料の二次調達先**（型2）。qualify/qualifying 9件のうち顧客文脈は上記の営業支援1件のみで、残りはCHIPS法の税額控除・税制・Schedule II『Valuation and Qualifying Accounts』。switch 2件は『wavelength selective switching』『optical circuit
